Evaluation brackets: dynamic variable names, and extra brackets re-evaluate.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test {
  set %a [ $+ b ] 1
  set %a [ $+ c ] 2
  echo -s ab = %ab
  echo -s ac = %ac
  unset %a [ $+ b ] %a [ $+ c ]
  echo -s gone = %ab %ac
  set %x % $+ y
  set %y Hiya!
  echo -s [ [ %x ] ]
  echo -s [ %x ]
  var %nick = bob
  set %seen. [ $+ [ %nick ] ] yes
  echo -s %seen.bob
}
-- output --
ab = 1
ac = 2
gone =
Hiya!
%y
yes
